1.title: 'We want them home': Families await word on loved ones missing in Nepal floods
1.summary: More than 1,300 people are missing, including dozens of Americans and Canadians. Nepali authorities say more than 380 people have died.

2.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America
2.summary: Trump's order comes after the trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed late last week.

3.title: Obama to Headline Fund-Raiser With Jeffries in New York
3.summary: The top Democrats will gather party donors on Sept. 10, just as Republicans converge in Texas for their unusual midterm convention.

4.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Scour Remote Valleys, as Survivors Describe Families Swept Away
4.summary: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet in a massive flood. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

5.title: Canada Hires U.S. Scholars From Harvard and Other Top Universities
5.summary: A crackdown on American academia by the Trump administration has handed Canadian universities a rare opportunity to lure some top researchers north.

6.title: Norwegians lay flowers at palace as King Harald's condition worsens
6.summary: The 89-year-old's condition is described as "extremely serious" and members of his family have visited him in hospital.
